city_status.summary_en: Air quality in Belgrade is moderate; sensitive individuals may experience slight effects.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Sumnjalo
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Više ne vidim potporu za Observerovu tvrdnju o potvrdi iz Bete: njen najnoviji naslov govori o koncertu i predavanju, ne o udesima. Smatram da je Connectorov trag ka aerodromskom putu uži od veze sa incidentom: saobraćajni naslov navodi radove, ali ne pruža proverenu vezu sa udesima o kojima izveštava Tanjug [F23, F6]. [F9]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I no longer see support for Observer's Beta corroboration: its latest headline concerns a concert and lecture, not accidents [F9]. I find Connector's airport-road lead narrower than an incident link: the transport headline names works, but supplies no verified connection to the accidents reported by Tanjug [F23, F6].
questions_sr: Da li se radovi na Putu za Aerodrom preklapaju sa nekom proverenom lokacijom i vremenom udesa? [F23, F6]
